resources.string: Take turns tapping Spin. Your piece walks that many squares along one long road from the Start Gate to retirement.
At a fork you choose your road. Learn costs coins now and opens the best jobs; Work earns right away. Pay stops pay your salary when you pass them.
Buy homes, grow your family and collect memories. Each family member is worth 30 and each memory 20. Cover shops protect you from one kind of setback.
Short of coins? You borrow 50 and owe 60, and a fresh start costs 40 points, so borrow with care. A lucky coin lets you spin again once.
Reach a retirement square to stop; earlier retirees get a bonus and your homes sell with a market roll. The most coins, homes and memories wins. Same device only, and CPUs can fill empty seats.
Road games where players follow one winding path through a whole lifetime have been family favourites for well over a century.
Tap Spin to walk the road. Pay stops pay your salary when you pass them.
At a fork, pick your road. Learn costs coins now and pays more later.
Family and memories are worth points too. Retire with the most to win.
